Governance Risk Compliance

Tác Động Đến Quyền Riêng Tư

The effect of a process, project, or system on the privacy of individuals, often measured and documented through a formal assessment (PIA).

Quick answer: The effect of a process, project, or system on the privacy of individuals, often measured and documented through a formal assessment (PIA).

Why it matters

This definition is sourced from ISO 27001, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, MITRE ATT&CK and published by Protermify Cybersecurity as a static cybersecurity reference page.

Definition

The effect of a process, project, or system on the privacy of individuals, often measured and documented through a formal assessment (PIA).

Operational example

A privacy impact assessment is mandatory for any project involving personal data under GDPR.
